voci.titolo: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
voci.riassunto: Housing data deteriorated further in September, according to separate reports Tuesday.

voci.titolo: The Next Big AI Debt Wave Is Pushing Credit Swaps to New Highs
voci.riassunto: Gauges of credit risk for some of the biggest technology companies hit fresh highs on Tuesday, as investors brace for an onslaught of post-earnings bond sales they fear may overwhelm already overloaded debt markets.

voci.titolo: Brazil Readies China Bond Debut for as Soon as Next Week
voci.riassunto: Brazil is readying its debut panda-bond sale, which could take place as early as next week, according to a person familiar with the matter.

voci.titolo: It’s not just California’s billionaire tax. Wealth is on the ballot in the midterm elections.
voci.riassunto: Several states are dealing with ballot measures tied to taxing the rich — and there may be even more initiatives on this front in 2028.

voci.titolo: Lithium Miner PLS Markets $700 Million Bond in Expansion Push
voci.riassunto: PLS Group Ltd is returning to the US dollar bond market, braving a junk-debt selloff as the Australian lithium miner lines up investments to expand production.

voci.titolo: Carney Spent Oil Windfall on Tax Write-off, Budget Watchdog Says
voci.riassunto: Canada’s budget watchdog says new federal measures, including a major tax incentive for businesses, have more than offset a surge in revenues driven largely by higher energy prices.

voci.titolo: Canadian Dollar Hits Nearly One-Month High After Alberta Vote
voci.riassunto: The Canadian dollar posted its best day in roughly four weeks and outperformed most of its Group-of-10 peers after voters in the province of Alberta rejected the idea of separating from Canada.

voci.titolo: Treasuries Rise as Oil Retreats From Highest Levels in Weeks
voci.riassunto: Long-term Treasuries rose as benchmark oil prices retreated from the highest levels in weeks, at least temporarily allaying fears of further inflation.

voci.titolo: Bessent Sees No Spillover From France Bond Market’s Turmoil
voci.riassunto: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he doesn’t anticipate a spillover from the French bond market, which has seen surging yields that have in turn driven a broader conversation about the European nation’s finances.

voci.titolo: Gold Wavers as Traders Weigh US-Iran Talks, Fed Rate Path
voci.riassunto: Gold wavered as traders assessed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path and the status of negotiations to end the war in Iran.

voci.titolo: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
voci.riassunto: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

voci.titolo: India’s finance minister says market liquidity makes it easier for investors to exit
voci.riassunto: Sitharaman identified fuel, fertilizer and access to capital as risks for India’s economy in 2027.

voci.titolo: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
voci.riassunto: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

voci.titolo: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
voci.riassunto: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

voci.titolo: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
voci.riassunto: Investors expect the Fed to pause rate hikes in October, but Kevin Warsh's rejection of traditional communications practices and continued concern about inflation leave the decision uncertain.

voci.titolo: Wholesale prices jumped 6.3% annually in September, biggest gain since 2022
voci.riassunto: September producer prices were expected to increase 0.6% month over month and 5.5% annually, according to the consensus estimate by Dow Jones.

voci.titolo: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done
voci.riassunto: 'We see real risks the Fed will deliver another rate hike in two weeks' time,' one Fedwatcher warns

voci.titolo: U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting
voci.riassunto: The exchange comes as U.S. debt exceeds $40 trillion and 10-year Treasury yields remain above 5%, intensifying scrutiny of the fiscal outlook.
